description: List recent coding tasks, optionally filtered by status.

limit.description: Max number of tasks to return (default 10)

name: vibekit_list_tasks

outputSchema.description: Result envelope: ok=true with data on success, ok=false with error on failure.

data.description: Array of tasks with id and status.

error.description: Error message when ok is false (e.g. missing/invalid VIBEKIT_API_KEY, or an API error).

title: VibeKit List Tasks
